title: CLAUDE.md#Default to background-subagent dispatch chunk 8
summary: The dispatcher stays on main — it does NOT relocate into a feature worktree. A single session has one cwd and cannot live in N feature worktrees at once, so it coordinates **N features concurrently from main; the feature worktrees are pure integration surfaces** targeted via base + repo_path, never the dispatcher's working directory. (EnterWorktree relocation is an OPTIONAL convenience for a focused single-feature interactive session — not the default coordinating posture.)
